decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would not be acceptable in terms of their design, scale and position and would result in unacceptable harm to neighbours' living conditions by way of loss of outlook and daylight.  It is therefore considered to conflict with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), Emerging Local Plan Policies SC7, EQ3 and CC1 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines

Condition : 2 - The proposal would not be acceptable in terms of their design, scale and position and would fail to sustain or conserve the character or appearance of the property or area.  It is therefore considered to conflict with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), Emerging Local Plan Policies SC7, EQ3 and CC1 and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and a rear extension to existing basement.
